description: This Java class 'AttributesModifiedStrategy' implements a specific event handling strategy for 'AttributesModified' events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract event strategy, processing the event to update a ThingBuilder with modified attributes.

classes.name: AttributesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: Final class implementing event handling strategy for AttributesModified event by updating the ThingBuilder with modified attributes.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Method that applies the AttributesModified event to a ThingBuilder by setting the modified attributes.
